text.en: Children talk about holidays: Chandni went to a beach in Odisha, Ritika to the desert in Rajasthan, Gurpreet to Amritsar in Punjab and Nayan to the mountains of Sikkim.

After the holidays the classroom is full of excitement. Children bring colourful pictures and things from the places they visited.
Chandni visited a beach in Odisha. Ritika described the desert of Rajasthan. Gurpreet told stories of his grandparents' house in Amritsar, Punjab.
Nayan read out from his diary about the majestic mountains of Sikkim.
India has many kinds of regions: mountains, plains, coastal regions and deserts.
Write about a place you visited and ask friends about theirs.
